Non-Surgical Arthritis Knee Pain Relief in Hyderabad: Top Solutions

Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy9 March 2026

Introduction

Arthritis knee pain can be a debilitating condition that affects millions of people worldwide, including many in Hyderabad. It can significantly impact your quality of life and make even the simplest daily activities challenging. While surgery is an option for some, not everyone is ready or suitable for it. Thankfully, there are effective non-surgical treatments available to help manage arthritis knee pain and improve your quality of life. At Apollo Hospitals, Financial District, Hyderabad, Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy specializes in providing compassionate and expert orthopedic care to help you find relief from arthritis knee pain without surgery.

Understanding Arthritis and Knee Pain

Arthritis is an umbrella term for over 100 different joint diseases, with osteoarthritis being the most common type affecting the knee. It results from the wear and tear of the cartilage, leading to pain, swelling, and reduced mobility. Rheumatoid arthritis, an autoimmune condition, can also affect the knees, causing inflammation and pain. Understanding the specific type and cause of your arthritis knee pain is crucial for determining the most effective treatment strategy.

Symptoms to Watch For

  • Persistent knee pain or tenderness
  • Swelling or warmth over the joint
  • Stiffness, especially in the morning or after rest
  • Limited range of motion or difficulty bending/straightening the knee
  • Grinding or clicking noises during movement
  • Formation of bone spurs around the knee

Treatment Options

Living with arthritis knee pain doesn't have to be a daily struggle. A range of non-surgical treatments can help manage symptoms effectively:

1. Physical Therapy: Engaging in a structured physical therapy program can help strengthen the muscles around the knee, improve flexibility, and reduce pain.

2. Medication: Non-steroidal anti-inflammatory drugs (NSAIDs) and analgesics can provide relief by reducing inflammation and pain.

3. Injections: Corticosteroid or hyaluronic acid injections can be administered directly into the knee joint to help decrease inflammation and improve lubrication.

4. Lifestyle Modifications: Weight management, regular low-impact exercise, and using supportive devices like braces can significantly impact knee health.

5. Alternative Therapies: Acupuncture, massage, and nutritional supplements may offer benefit in managing arthritis knee pain for some patients.

These treatments can often be combined to optimize results, and Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy at Apollo Hospitals, Hyderabad, can guide you through creating a personalized plan tailored to your needs.

Frequently Asked Questions

Q: Is exercise safe for arthritis knee pain?

A: Yes, exercise is not only safe but also beneficial. Low-impact activities help strengthen muscles and maintain joint flexibility, reducing pain.

Q: How do corticosteroid injections help?

A: Corticosteroid injections decrease inflammation in the joint, providing relief from pain and swelling.

Q: Can lifestyle changes really make a difference?

A: Absolutely! Maintaining a healthy weight can reduce stress on the knee joint, and an active lifestyle improves overall joint health.
